svg.text: PMODE low = PH/EN; 20 kHz drive/brake PWM. EN low = brake.
nSLEEP low = high-impedance coast; firmware ramps before STOP.
IMODE floating = 25 µs fixed-off-time regulation, latched overcurrent fault.
Ilimit ≈2.5 V / (9.8795 kΩ × 450 µA/A) = 0.562 A; prototype setting.
J2: PA25-24126000-G23 ONLY; rated 12 V / 250 mA, two wires.
0.56 A regulation is not a continuous motor rating. Stall duration is unknown.
Firmware overload shutdown and board-temperature trip do not measure winding temperature.
C23: 470 µF / 25 V; rail clamp is on sheet 04. No external VM power injection.
